confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregated cost-of-living estimates from crowdsourced and dated sources (some from 2023), so they are approximate. Beer and wine are less certain: beer is anchored to published domestic draft estimates, and the wine-by-the-glass figure is derived from an Expatistan bottle price using the local beer-to-wine relationship, not a direct menu price. The cocktail figure is a rough Expatistan benchmark. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Santa Marta's coastal lodging market; no booking pages or current listings were inspected, and these are the least certain values. Tourist zones such as El Rodadero and Taganga may run higher. The FX value is the RBA daily table entry for 2026-11-19 as surfaced in search; it was not verified against the live page, so confirm it there.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Santa Marta's own published cost-of-living estimates for food and drink, cross-checked against nearby Colombian Caribbean coastal tourism pricing. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for a mid-sized Colombian Caribbean beach resort city.
